audit.scope: Original 4194304-byte ROM only; no build, engine changes, emulator execution or external services. Hex offsets are ROM file offsets; pointerOffsets are decimal byte offsets. sourceHex excludes the NUL terminator; end-exclusive source bound is offset + sourceHex.length / 2, and that byte must be NUL.

noPointerAudit.bounds: Extractor range 12fff4..1679ae (end exclusive), 394 NUL-heuristic candidates. Output retains all 394 exact sourceHex, decoded scan source, endOffset, pointerOffsets and unalignedPointerOffsets. No scan candidate is silently dropped.
noPointerAudit.resourceEvidence: 192 candidates are aligned numeric fields in 36-byte records: six numeric resource offsets, two ROM pointers to cataloged festival text, then flags. Each match verifies both text pointer fields and all six numeric bounds. 44 candidates are the last three bytes of a negative 32-bit position at record+24, followed by another negative position, preceded by four valid resource pointers at +8,+12,+16,+20; examples 13db50, referenced at 30158 and 30df0. These are data fields, not computed text addresses.
noPointerAudit.fragmentEvidence: 22 candidates fit inside referenced translated catalog owners with exact source bytes and control-aware terminators, including 06:00-truncated dialogue. --unreferenced retains every owner offset/end, catalog/status, pointer offsets and fragment displacement. One candidate 13ebbf includes five binary bytes before text start 13ebc4 and ends at the same NUL. Coverage means catalog ownership, not verified installation or natural gameplay.
noPointerAudit.additionalBinaryEvidence: All 117 formerly unresolved short candidates have owning structures: 28 resource-offset triples (13296c/133fd8), 58 numeric-record fragments (136af4/136de0/138808/13b700/13d23c/13ed04/13f108/132b0c), 13 selection sentinels, 3 cross-table fragments (1308cd/132b2f/133f35), 6 opcode-5a Thumb callback pointer fragments, and 9 signed -90 operands of event command 46. Script output records table bounds, record stride, field position, literal references and reviewed consumer addresses; exclusion is not based on kana density.
noPointerAudit.unresolvedEvidence: The previous 134 unresolved comprise 117 binary fragments plus these same 17 readable drafts, not 134+17 independent missing messages. All 17 lack exact aligned/unaligned absolute references. They are unreferenced-not-installed: neither proven dead code nor proven player-visible missing text. Related menu/item/minigame/race owners and relocation limitations appear in --no-pointer-report. No computed text owner was proven, so no references are authorized for patching.
noPointerAudit.unalignedEvidence: Scan every byte position, including targets inside candidate strings. Exact unaligned hits 13181c <- dfe8f and 131d28 <- 60d8a target numeric resource fields. Among the 17 readable records, one interior hit 130347 <- 30d68e targets only the final ! of 130326 in resource data near 30b3f0; it is not a proven renderer reference. No blind patching; raw interior matches are retained separately from approved pointers.

falsePointerEvidence.161f20: Inside <KANJI:81> of translated owner 161f18. Match a2b2c lies in PCM payload a2694..aa5b9: song table 51960 -> header 12fdd8 -> instrument bank 4fc78 -> instrument 5 at 4fcb4 -> wave a2684, with 16-byte header and 0x7f25 samples. Not a text pointer.
falsePointerEvidence.167808: Inside <FMT:%s> of translated owner 1677f4. Match 297730 lies in pair-compressed resource 29718c..29ab4f, referenced at 2d498; decodePairs consumes 14787 bytes and yields 28576 bytes. Not a text pointer.

noPointerAudit.coverageLimit: Zero confirmed independent player-visible missing records in this no-pointer audit is not zero missing text in the game. The 17 drafts, graphical text, compressed/image-only surfaces and natural event reachability are not counted as translated. Shift-JIS work is separately owned and unchanged here.
noPointerAudit.engineReportingLimit: The unchanged prepareFullDialogue implementation puts all non-translated-draft statuses into its raw blocked list, including excluded-nontext and unreferenced-not-installed. That raw count is not a semantic inventory of missing gameplay text. Use --no-pointer-report for the audited classifications; no engine/build/test changes or reference patches were made.
noPointerAudit.diagnosticEvidence: 163878..163880 is the literal <09>もじのてすと<09> (text test), with no absolute pointer. Classified diagnostic, source retained by --unreferenced. No natural call path claimed.

Literal 36e2c -> 13e814; 36d6e..36d86 indexes by 4, calls 3d180 at 36d7c and stops after five labels. 36d9c..36da0 creates five choices. 36dbc..36dce reads the selected index and stores it in bits 5..7 of byte 03000004. The exact-target word at e8298 occurs in resource data, NOT a proven text caller. Do not patch it. This resolves the 22nd kanji candidate as an already-covered suffix, not a 22nd independent label.
evidence.no-pointer-text: See noPointerAudit and --no-pointer-report. Exact byte/NUL bounds and empty exact-target aligned/unaligned searches are proven; raw interior matches are separately retained, not authorized for patching. These 17 translations are unreferenced-not-installed review drafts, not 17 proven player-visible blockers or certified dead strings. Nearby referenced strings are separate NUL-terminated owners, not evidence that these bytes are translated by those owners. No computed caller or safe relocation is proven. %s at 13634c/136376 also requires argument provenance, width and buffer bounds. Decoder %て/%え denotes source ASCII %s/%d.

followupOwnerTrace.scope: Static follow-up for all 17 unreferenced drafts. Addresses are original ROM file offsets; CPU addresses add 08000000. No new owner or insertion site proven, no natural gameplay checks, no ROM/save changes. These observations support legacy-text hypotheses, not global unreachability.

The last39e572 match is record1151 in F0 map resource39b878..39fb7a, referenced by13f8d8/13f920/13f968/13f9b0 in the same72-byte map table. Corrected launch uses house initialization and native wrapper3de98 -> cleanup38124/44278 -> real dispatch3de64/table167e14. All17old starts are CPU-read watched in08/0a/0c mirrors with verified RAM-config and ROM-rules positive controls; none read in the completed cases.

controlledRuntime.limits: Controlled entry, not natural NPC discovery. Stage success, record-only UI, other ranks, outer events, DMA, interior-only reads and preexisting RAM copies remain unverified. No global unreachability claim.

followupOwnerTrace.result: 17 drafts remain unreferenced-not-installed. Two racing labels have confirmed installed equivalents in the same module; one item message has a confirmed split-message equivalent. Seven residual arithmetic candidates now have non-text ownership evidence. Controlled minigame checks add coverage but no new insertion owner. No arbitrary pointers or original string slots were patched.

engineAdaptations: Dispatch by sourceEncoding before custom sourceTokens/findTextEnd. Validate Shift-JIS with a fatal decoder and byte NUL bounds; do not pass source Shift-JIS through the custom dialogue parser.

Five stage-selector records are translated-draft with exact Shift-JIS source validation and caller gating. Verified ROM path: stage loop 36d7c -> 3d180; 3d1b8 -> formatter 3d5c0; 3d204 -> decoder 3ce80. Signed-byte branch 3ce8e -> 3cf26 returns 02 unchanged via 3cf32 without advancing the cursor. Unsigned (code-3)>7 at 3d212..3d216 dispatches 02 to existing sjis_glyph_hook at 3d2ac, with r5 pointing to the text cursor and r8 bank zero (3d1ee, reset 3d2c0). chinese_tile consumes two ID bytes; 3d2fa..3d2fe adds one, totaling three bytes per Chinese glyph. No assembly bridge is needed. Static instructions and source hook contract are unit-tested; no new build or natural-event rendering verification is claimed.

Each stage source is 10 bytes plus NUL, five displayed glyphs. Translation is three displayed glyphs, no controls or formats. Repoint only the five reviewed table words after encoding; preserve table order, five-item selection and the 03000004 stage bits.
Keep excluded-nontext diagnostic records and covered suffixes out of insertion and missing-player-text totals. blocked records must continue to prevent a full-translation claim.
No-pointer candidates need a proven computed/relative owner before insertion. Neither an empty pointerOffsets list nor a resource-zone byte match authorizes relocation.
audit.remaining: No-pointer audit classifies all 394 candidates: 355 binary/diagnostic/misbounded exclusions, 22 owner-covered fragments, 17 unreferenced-not-installed text drafts, zero unclassified candidates. Two separate aligned false-pointer blockers are excluded with container/token evidence. No independent player-visible omission or computed text owner was proven in this scope. Actual missing-player-text total is unknown; graphics, endings, compressed surfaces, installation and natural gameplay are not certified. Shift-JIS entries are unchanged by this audit.
